notes.title: Update 1.1.5 + New Features
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Car fans![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/4dc1ea7e583218058e128f5e094e03a14a50b447.png[/img]

[list]
[h3]Update 1.1.5[/h3]
[*] [b]Black Market[/b] and [b]Law Park[/b] blockade depending on the level of lawfulness
[*] Balance of price negotiations in telephone sales
[*] Improvements to the car sales process, including increased overkill when selling cars and checking the most important tag for the customer when offering the car
[*] Reduced the penalty for offering a car without meeting any tag
[*] Renamed cars
[*] New interface in applications on the phone
[*] New calculation of car prices
[*] Improving the recording of the game start frequency of random events (works from a new game)
[*] Increased game optimization by more than 100% more frames per second
[*] Fixed a bug in which the mechanic could not be assigned to another car, when a save was loaded, in which he was repairing some car
[*] Fixed a bug where there were no new cars at [b]LMG Home[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug with wrong display of the time to get out of jail
[*] Fixed a bug with reassigning car mechanic after loading a save with a repair in progress
[*] New market 
[*] Selling cars through the application on the phone
[*] The frequency of clients has been increased in relation to reputation + in relation to game difficulty level
[*] The desired profit from the car [i](+ x% in car info)[/i] was changed to global, i.e. set for all cars at once and not separately 
[/list]

notes.title: New Phone and more - Update 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5f8011bacdde71a3549c2f905a2168752fb27d03.png[/img]

[b]With update 1.1 we wanted to give you something special. We've added "LMG HOME" browser on the new phone where you can find LMGSCOUT and DarkCars. These are new auction portals to give you more possibilities to buy cars. Our next goal is to create more spots where you can sell cars.  We are also working on a new car pricing formula! Thank you for your feedback. It's amazing to receive so many messages with suggestions and ideas on how to improve CTS. Stay healthy and enjoy the new update. If you want to share your ideas with us, do not hesitate to reach us on our Discord channel[/b] 
~ Faci  [i]CTS Producer [/i]

notes.title: MAJOR Update 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5f8011bacdde71a3549c2f905a2168752fb27d03.png[/img]

[h2]Major Update is LIVE now[/h2]

With your help and suggestions, we fixed many bugs in our prologue. Major issues such as game-saving or screen freezing at the start of the game have been resolved. [u]Finally, we got rid of the tutorial-related bugs[/u]. A German translation created entirely by the community of our game has been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/1ed7c929ab67db8a756853954530656fe3310639.png[/img]

[list]
[h3]Update 1.0.0.7[/h3]

[b]Our changes[/b]
[*]Added an option to switch Miles to Kilometres in settings
[*]Added Encyclopedia where players can find detailed explanations of most aspects of the game
[*]Automatic selection of the text when changing the employee/garage name or entering your own amount in the auction
[*]Fixed issues with Inputs/Keybindings
[*]Fixed Save/Load issues
[*]Fixed saving of goals progress in Sandbox mode
[*]Fixed an issue where you could display a car from map legend
[*]Fixed a bug where repeatedly pressing the Escape button would cause Menu buttons disappear
[*]Fixed a bug with cars during the transaction (the car is seen as sold even after the end of the auction / Deal is processing)
[*]Fixed an issue with displaying the logo of your company in Sandbox
[*]If players want to skip the cutscenes now they have to confirm it by pressing the button again
[*]Improved text integrity of the game
[*]Improved loading of campaign mode
[*]Improved visual effects
[*]New mouse cursor
[*]Performance improvements
[*][u][i]Visual and mechanical Improvements in Tutorial[/i][/u]

[u][b]Changes with the help of the community[/b][/u]
[*]Added a full German Translation thanks to our community
[*]Added an option to exit the tutorial
[*]Improved and expanded Tutorial
[*]From now on players can type in how much they want to offer on auctions 
[*]We’ve added clickable pause/resume controls on the bottom of the screen
[*]We’ve added our community translators in Credits
[/list]


[i]"Hello everyone, thanks to your feedback we know that it was hard to play and enjoy CTS but we came with some cool solutions for you. We IMPROVED AND EXPANDED TUTORIAL so entering the game should be easier than ever. Everything is BIGGER, CLEANER (in terms of explaining how does stuff works) and WAY MORE EFFECTIVE for players. As a producer, I want to deliver the best possible user experience for each player so we didn't only bring new Tutorial but we've added ENCYCLOPEDIA. It's available on top of the screen on Sandbox and Campaign Mode. We explained most parts of the game with TEXT and GIFS, it's very accessible and simple. It's the best way to get in-depth with Car Trader Simulator. There are more features planned to come in both full game and prologue version so stay tuned for future devlogs and enjoy the update"[/i] ~ Kamil, Producer

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - "Tips & Tricks"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5f8011bacdde71a3549c2f905a2168752fb27d03.png[/img]

Today we would like to share with you a few pieces of information, which will be useful while playing Car Trader Simulator Prologue. 🚗🚕🚙

[h2]5 Tips & Tricks[/h2]

[b]1. Plan your road for Thiefs, Player, Mechanics and Drivers![/b]

[olist]
[*] Hold Shift and Righ Click on the map.
[*] Plan your road.
[*] Click ESC to delete it.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37570178/5ba8283d860a7c8a0a862f394b926692e08a6f36.gif[/img]

[b]2. Need more spaces in the Garage?[/b]

[olist]
[*] Buy your Drivers larger Trailers.
[*] Hold there Cars.
[*] Switch the needed Cars between the Trailers and the Garage.
[/olist]

[b]3. Your opinion is crucial! Feel welcome to share with us at any time.[/b]

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1296280/discussions/0/2567563897029287437/]Bugs and problems.[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1296280/discussions/0/2567563897029289280/]Ideas and Suggestions[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1296280/discussions/0/2567564516572381206/]Errors in translating the game[/url]
[/list]

[b]4. Is the Car locked from the last buyer, so you can`t change the Colour or Check the Profit-Price?[/b]

[olist]
[*] Switch to another car in the garage and back. 
[*] It should be displayed. (works only with a second Car)
[/olist]

[b]5. If you feel lost in-game.[/b]

[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1296280/discussions/0/2567563897029293272/]Ask devs - We are here to help you[/url]
[*] Look into YouTubers videos.
[*] Watch our official tutorial to see and know more. 
[/list]

[previewyoutube=GlLps6enxHE;full][/previewyoutube]

❗ [UPDATE] Right now our priority is:
[list]
[*] Resolving loading and saving bug.
[*] Reduction of clicking in the game. 
[*] Releasing update as soon as possible.
[/list] 

Thank you for your active participation in building prologue! We are very happy and thankful for your opinions and ideas. For us, developers, it's a true pleasure to have a great community like that! ❤

[b]Do you know some other tips or tricks? Share with us in the comments below.[/b]

Best regards
Car Trader Simulator team

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.5 + Official tutorial video
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players,[/b][/h1]

[h3]We have received a lot of information in recent days regarding bugs in the game and more importantly a "[b]tutorial[/b]". To help you understand the basic mechanics in the game and show some tricks we have created an [b]official tutorial video[/b] in which we will discuss in detail the most important things in the game.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=GlLps6enxHE;full][/previewyoutube]
